title: The Future Glory of Zion

questions.question: Arise, shine, for your light has come, and the glory of the LORD has risen upon what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 60:1 (ESV): "and the glory of the LORD has risen upon you."

questions.question: For behold, darkness shall cover the earth, and thick darkness the peoples; but the LORD will arise upon you, and his glory will be seen upon what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 60:2 (ESV): "and his glory will be seen upon you."

questions.question: And nations shall come to your light, and kings to the brightness of your what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 60:3 (ESV): "and kings to the brightness of your rising."

questions.question: Lift up your eyes all around, and see; they all gather together, they come to you; your sons shall come from afar, and your daughters shall be carried on the what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 60:4 (ESV): "and your daughters shall be carried on the hip."

questions.question: Then you shall see and be radiant; your heart shall thrill and exult, because the abundance of the sea shall be turned to you, the wealth of the nations shall come to what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 60:5 (ESV): "the wealth of the nations shall come to you."

questions.question: A multitude of camels shall cover you, the young camels of Midian and Ephah; all those from Sheba shall come. They shall bring gold and frankincense, and shall bring good news, the praises of whom?
All the flocks of Kedar shall be gathered to you; the rams of Nebaioth shall minister to you; they shall come up with acceptance on my what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 60:7 (ESV): "they shall come up with acceptance on my altar,"

questions.question: Who are these that fly like a cloud, and like doves to their what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 60:8 (ESV): "and like doves to their windows?"

questions.question: For the coastlands shall hope for me, the ships of Tarshish first, to bring your children from afar, their silver and gold with them, for the name of the LORD your God, and for the Holy One of Israel, because he has made you what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 60:9 (ESV): "because he has made you beautiful."

questions.question: Foreigners shall build up your walls, and their kings shall minister to you; for in my wrath I struck you, but in my favor I have had what on you?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 60:10 (ESV): "but in my favor I have had compassion on you."

questions.question: Your gates shall be open continually; day and night they shall not be shut, that people may bring to you the wealth of the nations, with their kings led in what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 60:11 (ESV): "with their kings led in procession."

questions.question: The glory of Lebanon shall come to you, the cypress, the plane, and the pine, to beautify the place of my sanctuary, and I will make the place of my feet what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 60:13 (ESV): "and I will make the place of my feet glorious."

questions.question: You shall suck the milk of nations; you shall nurse at the breast of kings; and you shall know that I, the LORD, am your Savior and your Redeemer, the Mighty One of whom?
For bronze I will bring gold, and for iron I will bring silver, and for wood bronze, and for stones iron. I will make your overseers peace and your taskmasters what?
The sun shall be no more your light by day, nor for brightness shall the moon give you light; but the LORD will be your everlasting light, and your God will be your what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 60:19 (ESV): "and your God will be your glory."

key_verse_text: Arise, shine, for your light has come, and the glory of the LORD has risen upon you.
